name: Ha Yura
source:
The sister of the director of the veterinary clinic. She is very well acquainted with Haru. She used to secretly admire Haru and her heart would flutter at the thought of him. But after she was found out, Haru didn't want her anywhere near him.
She is actually the same kind of spirit being as Nuri, and she monitors the other spirit beings which live in the town. Although she watches over the spirit beings in place of a certain someone, she has recently been after an important something of Haru's.
It's a shame that because she likes children too much, all the neighborhood girls are cautious of her. With regards to children, she has some dangerous interests, and a personality where she charges without thinking.

[From in-game profile]
